VI.description: Round15 P15 v3: the static-launderer chain. seed (class constant) feeds Sensor:Carrier, a STATIC member, whose obj out is a Sensor-typed wire; that wire feeds the dynamic call Sensor:Tag. The editor cannot bind Tag at edit time (the wire is parent-typed), so the runtime value must select the implementation. answer=Temp Sensor while callTargets still name Sensor members is the proof of dynamic dispatch.
